dedupe_keys.name: horaires et arrets des transport publics gtfs

description: Horaires et arrêts des transport publics (GTFS) is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Administration des transports publics . The General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS) defines a common format for public transportation schedules and associated geographic information. GTFS feeds allow public transit agencies to publish their transit data and developers to use that data to write applications. Coverage: Administration des transports publics . The portal shows the English title as "Timetables and stops for public transport (GTFS)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Administration des transports publics . Its keywords include mobility, public-transport, gtfs, transit, its, transport-public. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.europa.eu/88u/.well-known/genid/a53c34baec8e6153dcbbde27a2c7e2ec). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
